Add Spare Rows to Each Class List

Source: R/class_list_functions.R
add_spares.Rd

Appends a specified number of spare (blank) rows to each unique school, class and teacher combination in a class list.

Spare rows retain available school, class and teacher information, while student-specific fields are left blank.

Column names are resolved using the package's configurable column-name system, including the spare indicator.

Usage

add_spares(class_list, no_spares = 3, include_spare_column = FALSE)

Arguments

class_list

A class-list data frame using configured or internal column names.

no_spares

Integer. Number of spare rows to add for each unique class combination. Defaults to 3.

include_spare_column

Logical. If TRUE, adds or updates the configured `spare` column, marking new spare rows with "Y". Defaults to FALSE.

Value

The updated class list, retaining the original column names and order, except that the spare indicator uses its configured name when `include_spare_column = TRUE`.

Existing spare indicators are preserved. Newly generated spare rows are marked "Y" when `include_spare_column = TRUE`.

Details

Schools are identified preferentially using `est_id`, falling back to `urn` and then `est_wonde_name`.

Classes are identified preferentially using `class_name`, falling back to `c_wonde_name`.

Spare rows retain all available school, class and teacher identifiers. Other character fields are blank and other data types are assigned NA.

The spare column name is taken from `get_column_names()[["spare"]]`, which defaults to "SPARE".

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
updated_list <- add_spares(
  class_list,
  no_spares = 3,
  include_spare_column = TRUE
)
} # }
